profile.name: Von Andrew M. Castillo
profile.intro: I'm Von Andrew Castillo, a developer who moves comfortably between immersive game mechanics, reliable backend systems, connected hardware, and purposeful web experiences.
profile.about: I enjoy translating an idea into an experience people can actually use - whether that means a suspenseful game sequence, a responsive interface, an efficient data model, or an Arduino-powered feeder.
